business_tagline_en: Electronic Invitations for All Your Occasions
color_palette_source: Extracted from actual Instagram posts: brown (🤎) used in general designs, green (💚) in henna night designs, gold/yellow (💛) in engagement designs, red/pink (❤️) in newborn designs. Palette adapted for elegant invitation business aesthetic.

tone_of_voice.ar: دافئ، شخصي، أنيق، احتفالي، محب، قريب من القلب
tone_of_voice.en: Warm, personal, elegant, celebratory, loving, heartfelt

imagery_style.description: Elegant invitation card mockups on warm backgrounds, soft natural lighting, Arabic calligraphy details, floral and decorative patterns, warm color grading with brown/gold tones
imagery_style.composition: Card-centric with decorative elements, flat lay style, phone mockup showing digital card

layout_notes.hero: Warm inviting hero with animated invitation card reveal, soft floral elements
layout_notes.sections: Elegant, spacious, card-based layouts with soft shadows
layout_notes.cards: Soft rounded cards with warm shadows, decorative borders
layout_notes.buttons: Primary: warm brown, Secondary: gold outline, Accent: green
layout_notes.backgrounds: Warm cream/off-white base with subtle pattern, occasional brown sections

identity_notes: Brand identity extracted from actual Instagram account analysis. Colors derived from observed emoji usage (🤎💚💛❤️) and typical invitation design aesthetics. This is a warm, personal, elegant brand focused on celebrations and special occasions.
